heading: Gold Loan EMI Default: When Your Pledged Jewellery is at Risk
tldr: Missing a single gold loan EMI does not immediately lead to the auction of your pledged jewellery.
Lenders must follow a specific recovery process, including sending multiple notices as per RBI guidelines.
You will typically receive a final notice period, often 30 days, before any auction proceedings can begin.
Borrowers have options like making partial payments or discussing loan restructuring to reclaim their gold.
Understanding the lender's policy and RBI rules empowers you to protect your assets even after a default.
caption:
Worried about your gold loan if you miss an EMI? Many think their jewellery is immediately lost. But that's not true! Lenders must follow clear rules and give you time. You have options to protect your gold, like making partial payments. Don't panic, understand your rights. Learn the full process and what you can do by reading our article.
